notes.title: Sweet Pea: Akena update!
notes.notes:

The Akena update brings a new boss "Akena". A large aquatic guardian with some serious anger issues that can be found in the Tributary near Pine Meadows. Best off to run at this point but Akena will be back for more. On top of Akena a later boss has be named Osiris! Who dwells deep in the Crystal Caverns. Also a number of fixes and adjustments have be implemented.  


Added Akena intro and chase. Sound AI and basic behavior pass

notes.title: The first Sweet Pea update is here!!!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38657123/a9c36de01a9b46e5843136d129b1fca084b89d53.png

The first Sweet Pea update is here!!!
This is  in large part a quality of life one  with many bug fixes that should greatly improve the player experience.

Fixed collision issue making menu inaccessible.

Fixed layer overlap stopping players from switching menu panels.

Fixed animation not playing in Gunther intro and chase.

Fixed UI animation not parenting properly.

Adjusted Ice/Leaf wings range of effect as well as an increase in burst force. 

Adjusted Ability's cross over to only include cosmetics. Giving greater player control.

Adjusted Foreground assets to allow better play visibility.

Adjusted Dynamic camera reaction time to maintain speed with Sweet Pea.

This is small update, but should help Sweet Pea continue to be built upon while maintaining a smooth experience for early access players. More will come soon. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38657123/8874c6531cde034a64b79cc4b9985955392c7b76.png
